name: 13-adopt-title-only-anchor
description: A legacy anchor matched by its title prefix alone (no repo or pr_number metadata, as the old sync adopted it) beside metadata-linked children. Both sides adopt the anchor by its title prefix: the old sync from its work-beads listing, and the decider since packet P4a-1, whose bounded all-status lookup keeps a listed item by title shape as well as by repo and pr_number metadata (this ended the pg2-nbkps exception, under which the new side did not adopt it because nothing but metadata linked a work item to its PR).
